headline: A police constable was martyred and two other people were injured when unidentified gunmen opened fire outside an additional sessions judge's courtroom at the Judicial Complex in Lakki Marwat, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, on Saturday, Express Tribune reports.

card.desc: Judicial Complex mein namaloom afraad ki firing, police ne tehqeeqat shuru ki

caption:
Lakki Marwat Judicial Complex mein firing, police constable shaheed!
Express Tribune ke mutabiq Saturday ko Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ke Lakki Marwat Judicial Complex mein additional sessions judge ki adalat ke bahar namaloom afraad ki firing se Constable Karamatullah shaheed aur 2 afraad zakhmi ho gaye. Zakhmiyon ko ilaaj ke liye Bannu muntaqil kiya gaya, jab ke police ne complex seal kar ke tehqeeqat shuru kar di hai.
Adalaton ki security ke liye kya hona chahiye? Comment mein batayein 👇
